feedback.scope: first floor revisions and start of second floor
feedback.userFeedback: Return entrance gallery to light doors; dark doors take too much attention. Office: entire north wall built out; large desk facing northwest instead of semicircle. Media: follow supplied vertical wood-slat TV-wall reference in our style; M2 door must be on west wall per blueprint. feedback.interpretation: Warm ivory glazed side-door leaves replace charcoal on both room and gallery faces. Rectangular walnut office desk with southeast task chair facing northwest and full north-wall cabinetry replaces the curved desk and compact bookcase; south console remains omitted. Media south TV wall becomes walnut slats with long charcoal-front walnut console, subtle TV backlight and under-console light; west entry opening remains on perpendicular wall. Gym equipment, storage furniture and decor are deferred; retain northwest closet and separate bath access. Begin five photographed second-floor spaces with consistent finishes.
feedback.resultingRevision: first-floor review r03; second-floor review r01

feedback.scope: floors 1–3 refinements, missing living room and all-bedroom flooring
feedback.userFeedback: Entry: match second-floor wood color. Office: TV and soundbar in north cabinetry, artwork and small printer cabinet right of entry door. Media: clear entry doors, collectible shelves right of doors, less intense TV wall, soundbar, ceiling and behind-sofa speakers. Great room: sibling artworks above both consoles. Kitchen: better island lights. Dining: explore larger table for ten versus square twelve, fill space below high window. Living room: baby grand, Cloud couch, sheer drapes, two blueprint-derived angles. Sunroom: rectangular six-seat table, better chandelier, sheer drapes. All bedrooms: hard floors with loose rug under beds. Owner bedroom: 55-inch TV and soundbar instead of dresser art, art above bed, platform and bedside underside LEDs. Owner bath: artwork above tub. Bedroom 2: correct bed/desk/door layout; clarified headboard WEST and entry at southern WEST wall, desk right of EAST window. Laundry: graphic and exact wording “Rinse and repeat..”. Clarified oak/rug applies to penthouse bedroom too.
feedback.interpretation: Preserve the individual bedroom identities and common warm modern palette. Propose rectangular 108 × 42 in dining table for ten, subject to actual circulation survey. Use plan-informed living room and explicitly record Bedroom 2 closet/door conflict rather than claiming its new layout is surveyed. All new images are proposals; measurements, products and trade details remain unselected.

Media: clear entry doors, collectible shelves right of doors, less intense TV wall, soundbar, ceiling and behind-sofa speakers. Great room: sibling artworks above both consoles. Kitchen: better island lights. Dining: explore larger table for ten versus square twelve, fill space below high window. Living room: baby grand, Cloud couch, sheer drapes, two blueprint-derived angles. Sunroom: rectangular six-seat table, better chandelier, sheer drapes. All bedrooms: hard floors with loose rug under beds. Owner bedroom: 55-inch TV and soundbar instead of dresser art, art above bed, platform and bedside underside LEDs. Owner bath: artwork above tub. Bedroom 2: correct bed/desk/door layout; clarified headboard WEST and entry at southern WEST wall, desk right of EAST window. Laundry: graphic and exact wording “Rinse and repeat..”. Clarified oak/rug applies to penthouse bedroom too.
feedback.interpretation: Preserve the individual bedroom identities and common warm modern palette. Propose rectangular 108 × 42 in dining table for ten, subject to actual circulation survey. Use plan-informed living room and explicitly record Bedroom 2 closet/door conflict rather than claiming its new layout is surveyed. All new images are proposals; measurements, products and trade details remain unselected.
